name: Craftsman's Writ: Small Silk Pack
summary: A transferable writ requests one Small Silk Pack and gives details for its delivery and payment. The writ is needed to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: A customer’s faded note asks you for one Small Silk Pack. It includes where to deliver the pack and how payment will be made. The writ can pass from hand to hand, but you need to hold it when the exchange is completed.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one Small Silk Pack.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the pack?
faq.answer: The writ provides delivery information, and the location is marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.

faq.q: Can I transfer the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
